description: Connect a deployed agent to a Wiro project, so it can run Wiro models, with no key in this chat. Without project_id it takes the project of this connection; project_id takes one from list_projects. Call it without confirm first: it shows the project, what it replaces, whether a running agent restarts and which wallet pays for the agent's model runs, and changes nothing. After the user agrees, repeat the call as its nextAction shows, with confirm: true. Connecting the same project again changes nothing and does not restart the agent; if the project's secret changed, restart the agent with control_agent. On a team agent this needs a team admin or the person who deployed it.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents.

confirm.description: false (default) only shows what would change. true connects the project.

project_id.description: The id of a project, as a string, from list_projects. Leave it out for the project of this connection.

name: bind_agent_project

applied.description: 1 when the stored project changed, 0 when it was already this one.

outsideList.description: The agent holds a project outside this list or a key saved earlier.

restart.description: scheduled: a running agent restarts with the project. none: nothing changed, or the agent is not running and reads it at its next start. failed: the project is saved, but the running agent needs control_agent restart.

wallet.description: Which wallet pays for the model runs the agent starts.

title: Connect an agent to a Wiro project
